newsitem.title: USA: Optimax says to buy Lillie Rubin Fashions.
newsitem.headline: Optimax says to buy Lillie Rubin Fashions.

text.p: Optimax Industries Inc said Monday that it has entered into a non-binding letter of intent to acquire Lillie Rubin Fashions Inc, a privately held chain of 38 retail stores, for $8.2 million in cash and securities.
The chain specializes in "special occasion" women's apparel with a focus on higher-priced fashions and accessories, a news release issued by Optimax said.
The company said that in July it announced the proposed acquisition of Forgotten Woman Inc, a chain of specialty women's retail apparel stores.
If consummated, the two transactions would initially represent businesses with 47 stores and projected annual revenues of about $41 million, Optimax said.
